title: CEMENTS & SEALER
summary: Applied-material code table, part 3: glass primer 9981286 (77a), rubber-to-glass sealer 9985051 (78b), grease-base exhaust sealer 9985020 (82a), sealing compound 3710409 (84a–84m, windshield/roof weatherstrips and moldings), rubber & water base adhesive 9985105 (85a, jack-cover caution sticker) and adhesive-sealer 9885126 (86a, windshield weld flanges).
notes_internal: Chart sheet (no drawing, no callouts): applied-material codes. PART cell = GM part number + description from the left column, repeated on every row of its group (on the page it is printed once per group).
Words hyphenated across line breaks in USAGE are joined (e.g. RE-/TAINER -> RETAINER); multi-line cells joined with a space.
Model box reads 19000 (all models), so models = [].
Title block reads 'CEMENTS & SEALER' (singular), unlike D6/D7/D9.
Rows with two UPC/SUB-GRP lines (77a, 78b) are written '1 / C07' and 'F / A'.
82a and 84d have blank UPC and SUB-GRP cells on the page.
84a UPC '1' sits at the edge of the binder hole but is legible.
9885126 (86a) printed with 98..., not 99...; copied as printed.

Circled 1, 3, 2 beside the 9985051 group (78a/78c/78d removed, only 78b left). Circled 4 in the blank space below it: a removed group, 9985018 cement with 9985027 alternate (rev 4, '&' written as a ¢-like ampersand). Rev 4 'was' set to 9985018 since that cement was removed; no replacement given.
